items.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
items.title_zh: 让 Nemotron 掌握现代希腊语：语料挖掘、检索适配与生成溯源
items.summary: The authors adapt NVIDIA's Nemotron retrieval stack to Modern Greek end to end, covering corpus mining, synthetic supervision, embedder and reranker training, reader fine-tuning and a new benchmark called HERA. After fine-tuning on 65,773 Greek retrieval pairs, a Nemotron 1B embedder lifts nDCG@10 from 0.362 to 0.835, and a LoRA-tuned 30B-A3B reader raises judged answer correctness from 29.4% to 66.9%.

items.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Reasoning Runtime for Long-Horizon Tasks
items.title_zh: Argus：面向长程任务的通用智能体推理运行时
items.summary: Argus is a persistent, self-evolving agentic runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer and Reviewer roles execute bounded missions over durable project state, admitting memories, skills, procedures and verifiers only after review and, where available, task-native verification. With model weights fixed, it reaches about 78% on SWE-Bench Pro versus 59% for Direct Copilot and 76.8% on AARRI-Bench, and after verification-gated self-evolution mature SWE-Bench waves use 21% fewer solve-input tokens per task.

items.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen3.8 Foundation Model and Qianwen Office Agent, Reseating Itself in the Enterprise AI Race
items.title_zh: 阿里发布 Qwen3.8 基座模型与千问办公智能体，重夺企业级 AI 竞争席位
items.summary: Alibaba unveiled the Qwen3.8 flagship foundation model with 2.4 trillion total parameters and 95B active parameters, alongside Qianwen Office for enterprise AI workflows. The base-model-plus-office strategy is described as leveraging DingTalk's enterprise footprint against Tencent WorkBuddy and ByteDance Doubao.

items.title: Cross-platform epistemic verification for improving factual reliability in AI-generated news summarization
items.title_zh: 跨平台认识论验证：提升 AI 生成新闻摘要的事实可靠性
items.summary: MECV is a post-hoc hallucination-correction framework that aggregates evidence from the source document, Wikipedia and open-web retrieval, then uses a multi-LLM jury with contradiction-aware consensus scoring and iterative minimal-edit refinement. Evaluated on SummEdits with GPT-4o-mini and DeepSeek-Chat as the verifier jury and Qwen-Plus as orchestrator, it improves factual consistency while preserving the semantic structure of the summaries.

items.title: Recursive Synthesis for Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks
items.title_zh: 面向长程终端任务的递归合成
items.summary: RST is a recursive verified synthesis framework that extends verified seed tasks, realigns verifiers and instructions, validates results in fresh sandboxes and reuses accepted tasks as seeds. Across fifteen rounds it produces 37,484 terminal-agent tasks at roughly $0.05 each, with median reference solutions growing from 67 to 374 lines and DeepSeek-V4-Pro pass@4 falling from 90% to 2.5%; fine-tuning on the resulting trajectories improves Qwen3.5 models by up to 10 points on terminal benchmarks.

items.title: Same Formulas, Different Semantics: Do Language Models Follow Modal Logic Specifications?
items.title_zh: 相同公式，不同语义：语言模型是否遵循模态逻辑规范？
items.summary: The authors build paired modal problems with identical premises and conjectures but different frame or domain conditions, verified by automated reasoning to carry opposite labels, and test whether models follow the stipulated semantics. Four of five recent models fall below a condition-only baseline under direct prompting, yet enabling reasoning mode raises DeepSeek V4 Flash from 4.4% to 88.1% on unchanged prompts.

items.title: Can Open-Weight LLMs Produce Kernel-Verified Coq Proofs? A Pilot Study
items.title_zh: 开源权重 LLM 能生成经内核验证的 Coq 证明吗？一项初步研究
items.summary: This pilot study gave six open-weight LLMs one attempt per theorem on 100 CoqStoq theorems and counted only proofs accepted by the Coq kernel, finding Gemma 4 at 12/100 and Llama 3.3 at 8/100 while three models verified none. Across 600 attempts the overall success rate was 3.5%, and no model verified a theorem with a long reference proof.

items.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
items.title_zh: 链式递归语言模型：面向多轮迭代推理
items.summary: Chained RLM is an inference-time architecture that calls the same underlying model repeatedly as fresh reasoning roots, each receiving the original problem and context plus a compact plain-text summary, a blackboard and durable artifacts written by predecessor roots. The paper describes the handoff mechanism, artifact workspace and evaluation protocol, and studies when fresh-context artifact continuation yields measurable accuracy gains over direct answering even with recursive tool calling.

items.title: TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.title_zh: 腾讯云 TencentDB Agent Memory：AI 智能体团队级记忆中枢
items.summary: Tencent Cloud's TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents that turns shared conversation context into a persistent store; it was trending on GitHub.
